what: Hubbell makes electrical equipment. One half supplies utilities with transformers, meters, insulators and grid protection; the other makes wiring devices, lighting and enclosures for buildings and industry.
customers: Electric utilities, data centre builders, industrial plants, and electrical contractors and distributors.
money: grid infrastructure, transformers, meters and protection equipment
wiring devices, enclosures and industrial controls
moat: Utility products qualified into grid specifications and bought from approved vendor lists, where long lead times and reliability requirements make switching rare.
risks: Utility spending cycles determine order flow
Debt of about $5.3 billion against very little cash
Revenue grew only about 4% last year after a strong period
Transformer lead times have normalised, reducing pricing power
opportunities: Return on invested capital of 15% with a 21% operating margin
Grid replacement and data centre connection drive multi-year utility investment
Analysts see about 26% upside from current levels
watch: Utility Solutions order growth and transformer pricing.
